name: mjolnir
description: See your whole cluster in one window — a native desktop app for Kubernetes, cloud access, and containers

scripts.dev: MJOLNIR_PORT=7845 npm run dev --workspace @mjolnir/server & npm run dev --workspace @mjolnir/web
scripts.lint:no-js: ! find packages apps e2e -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.cjs' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/dist/*' -not -path '*/release/*' | grep . || (echo 'JavaScript source files found: Mjolnir is TypeScript only' && exit 1)
scripts.verify: npm run lint:no-js && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.desktop: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && cd apps/desktop && electron .
scripts.dmg: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && cd apps/desktop && electron-builder --mac
